TEXT: Time flies, the sun is setting.

With Kuroneko's parents returning home late, she 
has to watch over her siblings. Hence, it's time to 
wrap this date up.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: In the end, it turned out like this...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Senpai...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Ah, no, it's nothing. It's getting late, I'll walk you 
home.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: No, we still have enough time.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Um... I'm sorry.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hmm? Why are you apologizing?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
We finally went on a date, and yet, we haven't been 
able to do anything that a couple would do...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What do you mean, what a couple would do...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: That's...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Heh. I wonder what your sister would do at a time 
like this...

Looks like Kuroneko is worrying over not making 
any progress during today's date.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Even if you are thinking like that, there's no working 
around it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
You're different from Kirino. So, shouldn't you do 
what you want to?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: What... I want to do, you say...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Let's see, I... want to watch the sunset with you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Then it's settled... H-Hey.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Oh, what is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Wanna... hold hands?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [font_size=28]Huh?[/font_size] Ah-

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: W-W-W-What are you saying...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Um, it's fine if we can't, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Holding hands in a place filled with all these people... 
You really are a shameless animal.

She was just complaining about progress, yet she 
gets this worked up over holding hands...

Honestly, it'll take a long time before we get to my 
image of what lovers should be. Still, it's nice to 
take things slowly.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: My bad. If you don't wanna, it's fine.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: I-It's okay.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Eh?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Let's-

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [font_size=28]hold hands...!　If that is the will of fate...![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hmm, well, here.

It may have been in her chuunibyou phrasing, but 
Kuroneko's giving her all right now. Accepting her 
offer, I lightly held Kuroneko's hand.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [font_size=33]Hyah![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: H-Hey, don't make weird noises...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: But, you grabbed my hand so suddenly...
So suddenly...? But you willingly put your hand out...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Ah...

I relaxed my grip but this time, Kuroneko's hand 
suddenly gripped mine.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...Shall we go?

Not sure if she's distracting herself from her 
embarrassment, but she pulled me along as we set 
out.
